members.name: syncCurrentPlayItem
members.note: the C09 on a hotbar change: updateController's in surv_client_tick_start (client_out c09_slot), a consumer's in sync_current_play_item (a CPK_C09 in client_out's ordered packet list, ahead of the packet it rides with; each sender syncs, so a press that sends nothing sends no C09)

members.name: onPlayerRightClick

notes: Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): creative, adventure, hardcore or game-type path; the game is survival at the pinned difficulty; enchanting is off. Formerly listed as missing: The creative-only paths (clickBlockCreative, sendSlotPacket, sendPacketDropItem, the creative reach) are not ported; creative and adventure modes are out of scope (dig.h). sendEnchantPacket is not ported: enchanting is off (world.conf). onPlayerDestroyBlock's client half predicts the break, but the tool damage and the block callbacks run on the server's C07 path, so there is no single native function for it.
